subject.title: [Feature]: Support Excel (.xlsx/.xls) and generic binary uploads in gateway / input_file

question: Should OpenClaw add a core Gateway/OpenResponses binary `input_file` receipt contract for Excel and allowlisted binaries, or narrow this issue to Excel while routing generic/provider-native file behavior to related trackers?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the remaining work defines public upload, storage, redaction, and tool-access semantics rather than a narrow bug fix.

options.title: Approve core binary receipts
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical Gateway workspace/persistence contract and require explicit MIME, size, URL, redaction, metadata, and tool-access rules before implementation.

options.title: Narrow to Excel receipts
options.body: Limit this issue to allowlisted Excel persistence and route generic binary/provider-native forwarding to broader file-input issues.

options.title: Defer to plugin/API design
options.body: Leave core behavior unchanged until a plugin or ClawHub package proves the workflow and any missing extension APIs are clear.

recommendation.title: Approve core binary receipts
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the canonical Gateway workspace/persistence contract and require explicit MIME, size, URL, redaction, metadata, and tool-access rules before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the best available routing candidate for the product/security contract decision from issue discussion plus recent Gateway/OpenResponses evidence.
